people.nameZh: 米哈伊爾·圖哈切夫斯基

heading.en: Origins and early Civil War commands

body.zh-Hant: 據《蘇聯軍事百科全書》，圖哈切夫斯基1893年生於斯摩棱斯克省的貴族家庭，1914年畢業於亞歷山德羅夫軍校，一戰時在近衛謝苗諾夫團任中尉，1915年被俘，1917年逃回俄國。1918年起在紅軍服役，1918年6月至1919年1月指揮東方面軍第1集團軍，1919年4月至11月指揮東方面軍第5集團軍，該軍參與將高爾察克軍隊逐出烏拉爾與西伯利亞。
body.en: According to the Soviet Military Encyclopedia, Tukhachevsky was born in 1893 into a noble family in Smolensk governorate, graduated from the Alexandrovsky military school in 1914, served as a lieutenant in the Semyonovsky Life Guards in the First World War, was captured in 1915 and escaped back to Russia in 1917. In the Red Army from 1918, he commanded the 1st Army of the Eastern Front from June 1918 to January 1919 and its 5th Army from April to November 1919, which helped clear the Urals and Siberia of Kolchak's forces.

командовал 1-й армией Восточного фронта (июнь 1918 — январь 1919)

heading.en: Fronts and suppression operations, 1920–21

body.zh-Hant: 同一條目載，他1920年2月至4月任高加索方面軍司令，戰勝鄧尼金軍；1920年4月至1921年8月任西方面軍司令，參加1920年蘇波戰爭。《俄羅斯史百科全書》提及，史達林與他在1920年華沙戰役指揮權上存在衝突。1921年3月他以第7集團軍司令身分參與鎮壓喀琅施塔得兵變，1921年4至5月又指揮坦波夫地區部隊。
body.en: The same entry says he commanded the Caucasian Front from February to April 1920 against Denikin, and the Western Front from April 1920 to August 1921 in the Soviet-Polish War of 1920. The Encyclopedia of Russian History notes conflicts between Stalin and Tukhachevsky over the command of the Battle for Warsaw in 1920. In March 1921 he commanded the 7th Army in suppressing the Kronstadt mutiny, and in April-May 1921 he led the troops of the Tambov district.

heading.en: Staff and district posts after 1921

body.zh-Hant: 條目記載，他1921年任紅軍軍事學院院長，1925年11月至1928年5月任紅軍參謀長，1928年5月至1931年6月指揮列寧格勒軍區，1931年起任蘇聯革命軍事委員會副主席兼紅軍軍備部長，1934年起任副國防人民委員，1936年起任第一副國防人民委員。他1935年獲蘇聯元帥銜，1928年著有《未來戰爭》，與同僚發展縱深戰鬥概念。
body.en: The entry records that he headed the Red Army Military Academy in 1921, was chief of the Red Army Staff from November 1925 to May 1928, commanded the Leningrad Military District from May 1928 to June 1931, and from 1931 was deputy chairman of the USSR Revolutionary Military Council and chief of armaments. He became deputy defence commissar in 1934 and first deputy in 1936. He became Marshal of the Soviet Union in 1935; Stoecker adds that he wrote Future War (1928) and developed the deep battle concept.

heading.en: Arrest and execution

body.zh-Hant: 《俄羅斯生活》1997年的文章稱，圖哈切夫斯基1937年5月26日被捕，被指控領導紅軍內的「陰謀」，同年6月11日與其「集團」被槍決。《俄羅斯史百科全書》則寫道，下令處決他的是史達林，發生在1937年大清洗期間；他與史達林的關係至今有爭議。
body.en: Russian Life (1997) states that Tukhachevsky was arrested on May 26, 1937, charged with leading a "conspiracy" in the Red Army, and that he and his "group" were shot on June 11, 1937. The Encyclopedia of Russian History says it was Stalin who ordered his execution in 1937 during the Great Terror, and that their relationship remains controversial.

heading.zh-Hant: 出身與一戰、1918年烏拉爾突圍
heading.en: Origins, First World War and the 1918 Urals march

body.zh-Hant: 據《蘇聯軍事百科全書》，布柳赫爾1890年生於雅羅斯拉夫省巴爾欽卡村的農民家庭，一戰時先為列兵、後為下士，獲兩枚喬治十字章，1915年1月重傷退伍。1918年3月他任車里雅賓斯克蘇維埃主席，捷克軍團叛亂後率被圍的蘇軍在烏拉爾行軍1500公里，同年9月與第3紅軍會合。1918年9月28日他成為首位獲紅旗勳章者。
body.en: According to the Soviet Military Encyclopedia, Blyukher was born in 1890 in Barshchinka village, Yaroslavl governorate, into a peasant family; in the First World War he served as a private and then junior NCO, won two St. George crosses, and was gravely wounded and discharged in January 1915. In March 1918 he became chairman of the Chelyabinsk Soviet; after the Czechoslovak Corps revolt he led the encircled Soviet troops on a 1,500-km march across the Urals, joining the 3rd Red Army in September 1918. On 28 September 1918 he was the first recipient of the Order of the Red Banner.

heading.zh-Hant: 1920–27年：克里米亞、遠東共和國與中國
heading.en: 1920–27: Crimea, Far Eastern Republic and China

body.zh-Hant: 同一條目載，1920年8月至11月他任第51步兵師師長，參與卡霍夫卡登陸場防禦戰與突擊彼列科普；1921至1922年任遠東共和國人民革命軍的軍事部長兼總司令，並進行軍隊改編、在沃洛恰耶夫卡擊潰白衛軍。1924至1927年任廣州中國革命政府首席軍事顧問，參與北伐。哥倫比亞百科全書也稱他1922年自海參崴驅逐日本干涉軍。
body.en: The same entry records that from August to November 1920 he commanded the 51st Rifle Division in the defence of the Kakhovka bridgehead and the storming of Perekop; in 1921-22 he was war minister and commander-in-chief of the People's Revolutionary Army of the Far Eastern Republic, reorganising it and defeating the Whites at Volochayevka; and in 1924-27 he was chief military adviser to the revolutionary government at Guangzhou, taking part in the Northern Expedition. The Columbia Encyclopedia adds that he drove the Japanese interventionists from Vladivostok in 1922.

body.zh-Hant: 條目記載，1929至1938年他任特別紅旗遠東軍司令，領導擊潰中國軍閥軍隊（1929年蘇中衝突）並在遠東建立防禦，1935年獲蘇聯元帥銜，1934年當選黨中央候補委員。條目生卒括號寫明他卒於1938年11月9日。哥倫比亞百科全書稱1936年封帥並於稍後清洗中罹難，1956年獲平反。美國記者萊昂斯記述，1929年紅軍在滿洲對中國作戰，布柳赫爾奉命統率入侵的紅軍，他先前以加倫之名在中國指導北伐的國民革命軍。
body.en: The entry records that in 1929-38 he commanded the Special Red Banner Far Eastern Army, led the defeat of Chinese warlord troops in the 1929 Sino-Soviet conflict and built the Far Eastern defences; he became Marshal of the Soviet Union in 1935 and was elected candidate member of the Central Committee in 1934. Its bracketed dates give his death as 9 November 1938. The Columbia Encyclopedia says he was created marshal in 1936, soon fell victim to Stalin's purge and was posthumously rehabilitated in 1956. American journalist Eugene Lyons wrote that in 1929 the Red Army fought a war against the Chinese in Manchuria with Blyukher, earlier Galen in China, at the head of the invading troops.

body.en: The Sakharov Center database chronology says Blyukher became head of the Far Eastern Front on 1 July 1938; the Generals.dk service table likewise has him commanding the Special Red Banner Far Eastern Army from 6 August 1929 until 1 July 1938 and then the Far Eastern Front until 22 October. The chronology adds that he was arrested on 22 October while being treated at Adler, was placed in the NKVD internal prison at the Lubyanka on 24 October, and died on 9 November in the prison doctor's office.

heading.zh-Hant: 出身與內戰：第一騎兵軍
heading.en: Origins and the Civil War: First Cavalry Army

body.zh-Hant: 據《俄羅斯史百科全書》，布瓊尼生於羅斯托夫附近，一戰中因勇敢獲四枚喬治十字章，1918年加入布爾什維克，先在察里津周圍組建騎兵支隊，後創建並指揮傳奇的第一騎兵軍，對白軍與波軍作戰。莫斯科市ГБУ«МАЦ»傳略載，1919年6月騎兵軍成立，同年11月擴編為第1騎兵集團軍，參加擊敗鄧尼金、波蘭軍與弗蘭格爾的多次戰役。波蘭國家記憶研究院的文章載，布瓊尼的部隊於1920年5月29日在烏克蘭戰線的利波韋茨至薩姆哥羅德克一帶首次與波蘭軍交戰。
body.en: According to the Encyclopedia of Russian History, Budyonny was born near Rostov-on-Don, won four St. George's Crosses for bravery in the First World War, joined the Bolsheviks in 1918, organised cavalry detachments around Tsaritsyn and then created and commanded the legendary First Cavalry Army against the Whites and the Poles. A Moscow GBU "MAC" profile adds that a cavalry corps was formed under him in June 1919 and expanded into the 1st Cavalry Army in November 1919, taking part in operations against Denikin, the Polish armies and Wrangel. An article of the Polish Institute of National Remembrance says Budyonny's units first came into combat contact with Polish forces on 29 May 1920 on the Lipowiec–Samhorodek sector of the Ukrainian Front.

heading.en: Early life: France, Civil War and Spain

body.zh-Hant: 據莫斯科市ГБУ«МАЦ»傳略，馬利諾夫斯基一戰時志願從軍任機槍手，1916年隨俄國遠征軍赴法國作戰，1919年返回俄國後在東方面軍參加對高爾察克的內戰，1930年畢業於伏龍芝軍事學院，1937至1938年在西班牙內戰中任軍事顧問。
body.en: According to a Moscow GBU "MAC" profile, Malinovsky volunteered as a machine gunner in the First World War, was sent to France in 1916 with the Russian Expeditionary Corps, returned to Russia in 1919 and fought on the Eastern Front against Kolchak in the Civil War, graduated from the Frunze Military Academy in 1930 and served as a military adviser in the Spanish Civil War in 1937-38.

heading.zh-Hant: 1941–44年：南方、西南與烏克蘭方面軍
heading.en: 1941–44: Southern, Southwestern and Ukrainian Fronts

body.zh-Hant: 傳略載，戰爭初期他指揮第48步兵軍，1941年12月24日至1942年7月28日任南方面軍司令，1943年2月20日至3月22日再任，1943年3月27日至10月20日任西南方面軍司令，1943年10月20日至1944年5月15日任烏克蘭第3方面軍司令，並參與史達林格勒戰役、右岸烏克蘭解放與雅西—基什尼奧夫攻勢。GlobalSecurity 稱他指揮的近衛第2集團軍在史達林格勒擊潰了德軍頓河集團。
body.en: The profile says that at the start of the war he commanded the 48th Rifle Corps, then the Southern Front (24 December 1941 - 28 July 1942 and again 20 February - 22 March 1943), the Southwestern Front (27 March - 20 October 1943) and the 3rd Ukrainian Front (20 October 1943 - 15 May 1944), and took part in the Battle of Stalingrad, the liberation of Right-Bank Ukraine and the Iasi-Kishinev Offensive. GlobalSecurity says the Second Guards Army he commanded routed the German Don group at Stalingrad.

body.zh-Hant: 傳略載，他1944年5月22日至1945年6月10日任烏克蘭第2方面軍司令，參加雅西—基什尼奧夫與解放羅馬尼亞、匈牙利、奧地利與捷克斯洛伐克之戰，1944年9月10日獲蘇聯元帥銜；1945年7月12日至10月1日任外貝加爾方面軍司令，在對日戰爭中橫越戈壁與大興安嶺進攻。GlobalSecurity 稱他與托爾布欣的方面軍於1945年2月13日解放布達佩斯。
body.en: The profile says he commanded the 2nd Ukrainian Front from 22 May 1944 to 10 June 1945, took part in the Iasi-Kishinev Offensive and the liberation of Romania, Hungary, Austria and Czechoslovakia, and became Marshal of the Soviet Union on 10 September 1944; from 12 July to 1 October 1945 he commanded the Transbaikal Front, whose forces advanced across the Gobi Desert and the Greater Khingan range in the war against Japan. GlobalSecurity says his and Tolbukhin's fronts took Budapest on 13 February 1945.

The profile says he commanded the 68th Army from February 1943, the Southern Front from March 1943 and the 4th Ukrainian Front from October 1943.
